features: TURNTABLE ORGANIZER – Streamline your kitchen organization with the iDesign Recycled Plastic Lazy Susan Spinner; it’s a quick and easy addition to your pantry or cabinet that will bring functional beauty and organized style

VERSATILE DESIGN – This spinning organizer features a smooth, rotating design that keeps all items visible and easy to access; it’s ideal for storing spices, cooking oils, condiments, and ingredients in the pantry, cabinet, or refrigerator
THOUGHTFUL CONSTRUCTION – Crafted from recycled plastic, this lazy Susan organizer is built to last; the transparent open-top design allows you to easily view contents at a glance

EFFICIENT SIZE – Whether you use it on its own or pair it with other iDesign kitchen storage organizers, it is just the right size to be functional without getting in the way; measures 11” in diameter and 1.75” tall

IDESIGN – iDesign offers innovative storage products at a reasonable price; we’re a global leader in housewares with a mission to make every day easier with innovative products designed to help people organize and enhance their homes with style
description: Streamline your kitchen storage with the iDesign Linus Collection Recycled Plastic Lazy Susan Spinner. It’s a quick and easy pantry or cabinet organizer that will add functional beauty and organized style in a snap. Measuring 11” in diameter and 1.75” tall, it’s the ideal option for making the most of small, compact spaces in the pantry, cabinet or refrigerator. It features a smooth, rotating design that keeps all items visible and easy to access, and is ideal for storing spices, cooking oils, condiments, and ingredients in the pantry, cabinet, or refrigerator. The transparent open-top design allows you to easily view contents at a glance. Aside from kitchen storage, you can also use this spinning organizer for cosmetics or nail polish storage, to store office supplies or display small toys. It pairs well with other items in the iDesign collection of storage containers to provide complete home organization in every room. Crafted from recycled plastic, this kitchen organizer is built to last. With iDesign, you can live simply every day.
